name: Josephson parametric phase-locked oscillator readout (Lin 2014)
question: Does pulsing the flux pump through the parametric threshold write the phase chosen by the qubit-set locking signal, and with which law?
assumptions: dq/dt = -kappa q/2 + dg/dq (Lin eqs. 2-3) with g of eq. 4; pump p = sqrt(P/P0), threshold at p = 1
Kerr gamma scaled so that the oscillating state holds ~100 photons; locking signal applied as the write field

provenance.source: Lin, Z. R., Inomata, K., Koshino, K., Oliver, W. D., Nakamura, Y., Tsai, J. S., Yamamoto, T., 'Josephson parametric phase-locked oscillator and its application to dispersive readout of superconducting qubits', Nat. Commun. 5, 4480 (2014), arXiv:1407.7195 (full text and supplement); Yamamoto, T., Inomata, K., Watanabe, M., Matsuba, K., Miyazaki, T., Oliver, W. D., Nakamura, Y., Tsai, J. S., 'Flux-driven Josephson parametric amplifier', Appl. Phys. Lett. 93, 042510 (2008), arXiv:0808.1386 (full text)
